name: Heritage Listing
definition: The relation between a specific site or object and a heritage register or list it is included in.

name: Event Participation
definition: The relation between a person or group and a specific event or competition they participated in.

name: Professional Role
definition: The relation between a person and the specific job title, position, or role they hold.

name: Location
definition: The relation between an entity and the geographic place where it is situated, located, or takes place.

name: Nationality
definition: The relation between a person or entity and their country of origin or citizenship.

name: Organizational Affiliation
definition: The relation between a person or entity and an organization, political party, or group they are a member of or affiliated with.

name: Product Origin
definition: The relation between a product, work, or entity and its creator, developer, manufacturer, or parent company.

name: Parent-Subsidiary
definition: The relation between a company or organization and its parent company, owner, or acquiring entity.

name: Geographic Subdivision
definition: The relation between a geographic entity and the larger administrative or geographic region it belongs to.

name: Kinship
definition: The relation between two people based on family ties, such as parent-child, sibling, or spouse.

name: Platform Compatibility
definition: The relation between a software, game, or media product and the hardware platform or operating system it runs on.

name: Record Label
definition: The relation between a musical artist or group and the record label that releases their work.

name: Creator
definition: The relation between a creative work (such as a film, book, or art) and its author, director, or primary creator.

name: Acquisition
definition: The relation between an entity that is acquired and the entity that acquires or purchases it.

name: Award Nomination
definition: The relation between a work, person, or performance and the award or nomination they received.

name: Identity
definition: The relation between an entity and its alternate name, alias, abbreviation, or former name.

name: Genre
definition: The relation between a work, publication, or broadcast and its specific category, style, or format.

name: Architectural Style
definition: The relation between a building or structure and its specific architectural style or design movement.

name: Sports League Membership
definition: The relation between a sports team or club and the league or division they compete in.

name: Military Service
definition: The relation between a person and the military branch or armed force they served in.

name: Part-Whole
definition: The relation where the first entity is a component, member, or part of the second entity, which constitutes a whole (e.g., a mountain range is part of a larger mountain system, a segment is part of a

name: Tributary
definition: The relation where a river or stream flows into a larger river or body of water.

name: Political Office
definition: The relation where a person holds or is a candidate for a specific government position or title.

name: Sports Team Affiliation
definition: The relation where an athlete, coach, or staff member is associated with a specific sports team.

name: League Affiliation
definition: The relation where a sports team or club competes in a specific sports league or division.

name: Event-Winner
definition: The relation where a person, team, or entity wins a specific competition, election, or award event.

name: Family
definition: The relation where two people are related by blood, marriage, or adoption (e.g., parent-child, sibling, spouse).

name: Group Membership
definition: The relation where an individual is a member of a specific group, band, or organization (distinct from professional employment).

name: Product Line
definition: The relation where a specific product or model belongs to a brand, company, or product line.

name: Military Unit
definition: The relation where a specific military unit, regiment, or vessel belongs to a larger branch of the armed forces.

name: Language
definition: The relation where a work, project, or entity is associated with a specific spoken or written language.

name: Political Party Affiliation
definition: The relation where a person, politician, or cabinet is affiliated with a specific political party.

name: Software Compatibility
definition: The relation where a software product, device, or feature is compatible with, included in, or designed for a specific operating system or software version.

name: Publisher
definition: The relation between a creative work (such as a book, music album, or film) and the company or entity responsible for publishing or releasing it.

name: Time-Event Association
definition: The relation between a specific point in time (year, date) and an event, season, or occurrence that happened at that time.

name: Team-Event Participation
definition: The relation between a sports team or national squad and a specific competitive event or tournament in which they participated.

name: Translation
definition: The relation between a source work and its translated version, or between different language versions of the same work.

name: Head of Government
definition: The relation between a political leader (such as a Prime Minister) and the country or administrative division they govern.

name: Language of Publication
definition: The relation between a published work, newspaper, or media outlet and the language in which it is written or broadcast.

name: Parent Organization
definition: The relation between an organization, institute, or division and the larger parent organization to which it belongs.

name: Profession
definition: The relation between a person and their specific occupation, professional field, or area of expertise.

name: Product Manufacturer
definition: The relation between a product, vehicle, or model and the company that manufactured or branded it.

name: Software Platform
definition: The relation between a software application or feature and the operating system or platform on which it runs.

name: Director
definition: The relation between a film, play, or production and the person who directed it.

name: Broadcast Network
definition: The relation between a television or radio program and the network or channel that broadcasts it.

name: Military Branch
definition: The relation between a person or unit and the specific branch of the armed forces (e.g., Army, Navy, Air Force) in which they serve.

name: Setting
definition: The relation between a creative work, such as a film or novel, and the geographic location where the story is set or where production took place.

name: Political Endorsement
definition: The relation between a candidate or political event and a person or group endorsing or supporting them.

name: Transportation Route
definition: The relation between a transportation system (like a metro or railway) and a specific line or route that operates within it.

name: Technology Owner
definition: The relation between a specific technology, software feature, or product and the company that owns or develops it.

name: Venue-Tenant
definition: The relation between a sports or performance venue and the team, club, or organization that primarily uses or occupies it.

name: Legislative Representation
definition: The relation between a geographic constituency or district and the elected official who represents it in a legislative body.

name: League Division
definition: The relation between a sports team or club and the specific competitive division or tier it competes in.

name: Birthplace
definition: The relation between a person and the specific location where they were born.

name: Medium
definition: The relation between a creative work and the artistic medium, format, or genre category it belongs to (e.g., short story, opera, sculpture).

name: Facility Type
definition: The relation between a specific named facility (like a military base or station) and the general type or classification of that facility.

name: Product Developer
definition: The relation between a product (typically software or a game) and the company or individual that developed it.

name: Composer
definition: The relation between a musical work and the individual who composed the music.

name: Geographic Part
definition: The relation between a larger geographic region and a smaller region or feature located within or adjacent to it.

name: Character
definition: The relation between a creative work (such as a movie, show, or book) and a fictional character that appears in it.

name: Broadcaster
definition: The relation between a program or show and the television network or channel that broadcasts it.

name: Educational Affiliation
definition: The relation between a person (typically a student or teacher) and the educational institution they attend or work for.

name: Origin
definition: The relation between a person or group and the geographic location they are from or where they originated.

name: Literary Form
definition: The relation between a writer and the literary form or genre they write in (e.g., novel, short story).
